LanguageData.RR_GateHistory_Desc: Everywhere this gate has connected to. Rename, pin, remove or clear entries. Each gate keeps its own list. A natural portal has no list at all - its destination is fixed where it was found and it cannot be dialled.
LanguageData.RR_GateHistory_Empty: This gate has not connected anywhere yet.
LanguageData.RR_GateHistory_Pin: Pin, so clearing never removes it
LanguageData.RR_GateHistory_Clear: Clear the list (pinned entries are kept)
LanguageData.RR_GateHistory_Cleared: Cleared {0} entries from this gate's connection history.
LanguageData.RR_GateHistory_CoordinateGone: That space is no longer on this branch's list of coordinates. The gate still remembers dialling it, but there is nothing left to connect to.
